$comment: Frozen oracle for SCN-SET-010 and SCN-SET-007. Truth source: this file (values the runner writes) and the response shapes of change uiux-config-boot-safety-and-live-reload design D6-D8. The runner computes digests itself from the bytes it writes.

bootFallback.procedure: start with fixtures/scratch-config.yaml (saved as last known good), stop, replace config.yaml with brokenYaml, start
bootFallback.interfaceRequirement: boot-status config.fallback must carry the rejected file's path (failed_source_path) in addition to digests; requested of uiux-config-boot-safety-and-live-reload (design D8 shows digests and key_path only)

drift.procedure: set the key to 7 in the console, stop, start with fixtures/scratch-config.yaml (YAML says 5)

reload.note: a YAML edit of a YAML-at-boot key is restart_required (taken from YAML at the next start); a DB edit of the same key is not_applied (settings-apply-status). The config change must report the YAML case as restart_required.

invalidControl.expected: console shows a rejected state with the failure class; no success text; GET /api/uar/settings/resilience.requests_per_second unchanged
